purpose: Choose how to express each stored scorer signal on paper: stock/short-stock proxy, single long option, or defined-risk debit spread.

live_replay_evidence.command: python main.py replay-score-strategy-allocate --start 2025-01-01 --scorer-name openai --model-name gpt-5.4-mini --scorer-version openai-replay-score-v14-nuanced-v1 --price-source yahoo_chart_daily_adjclose --limit 1000 --underlying-reference-price 100 --stock-quantity 10 --stock-stop-loss-pct 0.02 --min-confidence 0.35 --min-stock-expected-return 0.0025 --min-dte 7 --base-implied-vol 0.55 --risk-free-rate 0.04 --contract-multiplier 100 --moneyness-offset-pct 0.0 --spread-width-pct 0.05 --min-option-score 0.35 --min-option-return-on-risk 0.0 --option-preference-edge 0.05

known_limitations: Stock max loss uses a stop-loss proxy rather than simulated stop execution.
Option strategies are still theoretical Black-Scholes candidates and are not yet constrained by live bid/ask, open interest, implied-volatility surface, assignment, or margin.
Allocation regret is hindsight-only evaluation and must not be used as a signal-time selection input.
The current allocation policy selected fewer options than the pure theoretical options analyzer; M100 should tune expression selection with walk-forward validation.
